description: Fetch one Tweede Kamer record by its GUID id. Pass the entity name and the record Id (a GUID, e.g. "8b3664bd-77e4-468b-af96-f3f4ec27fcce"). Optionally narrow fields with $select or inline related records with $expand.

entity.description: Dutch entity name. Common: Persoon (people/MPs), Fractie (parties), Zaak (cases/motions/bills), Activiteit (activities/debates), Vergadering (meetings), Stemming (votes), Besluit (decisions), Document (documents).

name: get_entity_by_id
title: Get Entity By Id
